rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and policyholder sustaining whiplash and sprained wrist injuries; clear auto damage claim with a fault determination available via police report.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was struck from behind at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; the vehicle is totaled with severe trunk crush damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is available on the police report. Claim is high severity due to total loss and injury.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle going approximately 35 mph, other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled vehicle, entire trunk crushed into back seat
